mapper.update: UPDATE program SET seed_key=#{seedKey} WHERE id=#{id} AND seed_key IS NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM program WHERE 1=1
AND status!='DRAFT'
AND title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')
AND status='PUBLISHED' AND opens_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND closes_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
AND (status='CLOSED' OR closes_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT type_code FROM program_document_rule WHERE program_id=#{programId} AND required=TRUE ORDER BY id
